Notify.SizeNotLinked: {name}'s token did not change size with the form because "Link to actor size" is turned off in its token settings.
Notify.ApplyFailed: The form for {spell} could not be applied. See the console (F12) for details.

AutoApply.Name: Apply battle forms on cast
AutoApply.Hint: When a battle-form spell or Untamed Form is cast, ask the caster which form to take and apply its effect. Turn this off to apply effects by hand from the chat card; they still get the form's token art.

Transition.Name: Fade to the form's image
Transition.Hint: Fade the token to its new image when you apply a battle form. Read when the form is applied, on the computer of whoever applies it.

FormArt.Name: Form art
FormArt.Label: Manage form art
FormArt.Hint: See which image each battle form shows on the token and where it comes from, and set your own.

Art.Title: Form art
Art.Intro: The image each form puts on the token. Images come from your art modules through Foundry's compendium art, or from the creature in the PF2e compendium. Set your own for any form; it is used the next time the form is applied.

Source.none: No image: the token keeps its own
